remarks:
Why wait to build when you can enjoy all the benefits of new construction without the new build price tag? At just three years young, this beautifully maintained custom ranch offers the style, quality, and peace of mind you're are searching for.

From the moment you arrive, the warm and inviting curb appeal sets the tone for what's inside. Luxury vinyl plank flooring flows throughout the home, creating a seamless and modern feel. The stunning kitchen features granite countertops, beautiful cabinetry, all newer appliances, and a sliding glass door that opens to a concrete patio and fully fenced backyard, providing the perfect space for entertaining, relaxing, or keeping loved ones and pets safely at play.

The spacious living room is filled with natural light from oversized front windows and is centered around a gorgeous gas fireplace, creating a cozy gathering space year-round.

This thoughtfully designed ranch offers two full bathrooms, including a guest bath with a no-step shower for added accessibility. The private primary suite features a beautifully tiled walk-in shower with custom finishes and elegant glass doors, creating a true retreat.

Built with quality in mind, the home features a 10-inch poured concrete foundation, along with a tankless hot water heater, high-efficiency furnace, central air conditioning, and updated electrical system that are all only three years old. A whole-house generator provides added confidence that life keeps moving, no matter the weather.

The full basement offers impressive 8-foot ceilings and an egress window, making it ready for your vision. Whether you dream of a home theater, gym, recreation room, guest suite, or additional living space, the possibilities are endless.

This is the rare opportunity to own a nearly new home with today's sought-after finishes, exceptional mechanicals, and room to grow, all without the wait or expense of building from the ground up.
